annotations.title: Get One U Education service prices

description: One U Education's public service price list (the oneuedu.com service pricing page): visa applications (student 500, employer-sponsored 482/186, partner, parent, visitor, 485 and more), school applications, short courses (White Card, forklift, EWP, first aid and more) and other services, each with its description and public retail price — what the client pays One U Education for the service, no code needed. With the partner unlock code it also adds the agent settlement price (what a partner agent pays One U Education) and the agent profit. Prices are service fees only: government and other third-party fees are extra. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

category.description: visa (visa applications), school (school applications), course (short courses such as White Card, forklift, first aid) or extra (other services).

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

query.description: Words to match in the product name or description, in the result language (e.g. "482", "白卡", "forklift").

unlockCode.description: Configured partner unlock code (including email-shaped codes), the same one the page asks for. Trim outer whitespace; preserve case and internal characters. Must be non-empty, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, and contain no internal CR/LF. Pass it only when the user gave it to you in this conversation; never guess one. Not needed for retail prices: without it, products are listed with their public retail prices, and the agent settlement price and agent profit stay hidden.
